comment: The vectors pinning the one rule a harness session is rebuilt by (context.rs, the same file in each harness catalyst: claude-code and openai-codex). A chat request whose session is new is handed the history before its current ask (the last message) as parts: text, and the attachments the brain takes as media; a session the request names is handed none. Each case gives the brain's attachment kinds and media types, the bound of the line that carries the ask (line_bytes), the request's messages and the parts. A history of none (the current ask alone) is no parts. The second case's messages are what Aqua.Loop.Request.messages/2 makes of a crew member's thread (request_test.exs reads them), so the rule reads the projection the loop sends.

cases.name: the current ask alone is handed no history

content.text: Read notes/todo.md and say what is left.

cases.name: a crew member's new session is handed its thread in order, with who said it, its calls and their outcomes, then the current ask (Aqua.Loop.Request.messages/2's projection of the thread in request_test.exs)
